strings.zh: 最近都没人从满金市那边{NEWLINE}过来了呀。
strings.en: Lately, I don’t see people coming{NEWLINE}from Goldenrod City.

strings.zh: 从满金市和缘朱市来了好多人,{CLEAR}所以变得忙碌起来了！
strings.en: Things are busy lately, because{NEWLINE}we have many people coming{CLEAR}from Goldenrod and Ecruteak!

strings.zh: 西边36号路的关键路口{NEWLINE}被一棵奇怪的树给挡住了,{CLEAR}如果是满金市的咲小姐,{CLEAR}应该有办法挪开吧！
strings.en: The key junction on Route 36 to{NEWLINE}the west is blocked by an odd tree.{CLEAR}Ms. Saki in Goldenrod City should know{CLEAR}how to move it!

strings.zh: 啊——！你是在关东参加{NEWLINE}地下决斗的那个训练家,{CLEAR}你还记得我吗？{CLEAR}我当时使用哈克龙向你挑战{CLEAR}结果败下阵来。{SCROLL}从那之后我又去了好几个城市{NEWLINE}向不同的训练家挑战,{CLEAR}但结果都不尽人意,{CLEAR}徽章也没拿到几个。{CLEAR}从烟墨市出来旅行了这么久,{CLEAR}我都没有闯出什么名堂,{CLEAR}真是完全没脸回去……
strings.en: Ahhh! You’re that Trainer from{NEWLINE}the underground battles in Kanto!{CLEAR}Do you remember me? I challenged you{CLEAR}with my Dragonair back then and lost.{SCROLL}Since then I’ve gone from city to{NEWLINE}city challenging all kinds of Trainers,{CLEAR}but it never went well.{CLEAR}I’ve barely won any Badges.{SCROLL}I’ve been traveling so long since{NEWLINE}I left Blackthorn City, and I still{CLEAR}haven’t made anything of myself.{CLEAR}I’m too ashamed to go home...

strings.zh: 听说36号路通了,{NEWLINE}这样去满金市和缘朱市都方便了。
strings.en: I heard Route 36 is open now.{NEWLINE}That makes it easy to get to Goldenrod{CLEAR}City and Ecruteak City.

strings.zh: 南边的阿鲁夫遗迹{NEWLINE}是非常神秘的古代建筑群,{CLEAR}值得您驻足慢慢欣赏。
strings.en: The Ruins of Alph to the south are a{NEWLINE}very mysterious complex of ancient{CLEAR}structures. They’re well worth{CLEAR}stopping to take in at your leisure.

strings.zh: 阿鲁夫遗迹的研究员都好厉害,{NEWLINE}等我长大了也要像他们那样{CLEAR}研究古代遗迹、研究传说中的精灵。
strings.en: The researchers at the Ruins of{NEWLINE}Alph are so cool. When I grow up,{CLEAR}I want to be like them and study ancient{CLEAR}ruins and legendary Pokémon.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你的家在烟墨市吧？{NEWLINE}你爸妈都在家盼着你回去呢。{CLEAR}不要在意闯没闯出名堂,{CLEAR}还是先回家看看父母吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Your home’s in Blackthorn{NEWLINE}City, right? Your mom and dad are{CLEAR}waiting for you to come back.{SCROLL}Don’t worry about whether{NEWLINE}you’ve made a name for yourself.{CLEAR}Go home and see your parents first.

strings.zh: 啊！你在烟墨市见到过我爸妈？{NEWLINE}他们……他们还好吗？
strings.en: Ah! You met my parents in Blackthorn{NEWLINE}City? Are they... are they doing okay?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『嗯,他们的身体都很好,{NEWLINE}就是心里时常挂念着你。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Yeah, they’re both in good{NEWLINE}health. They just worry about you{CLEAR}all the time.

strings.zh: 唉,我也是好久没回家看他们了。{NEWLINE}只是现在混成这个样子,{CLEAR}我还有什么脸面回去啊。
strings.en: Sigh... I haven’t been home to see them{NEWLINE}in ages. But the way I’ve ended up,{CLEAR}how could I ever face them?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『家不是你炫耀脸面的名利场,{NEWLINE}而是当你累了需要修整时的避风港。{CLEAR}你的父母并不在乎你成功与否,{CLEAR}他们只希望你能平平安安回家。{CLEAR}所以快回去看看他们吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Home isn’t a stage for{NEWLINE}showing off how well you’re doing.{CLEAR}It’s a safe harbor for when you’re worn{CLEAR}out and need to rest.{SCROLL}Your parents don’t care whether{NEWLINE}you succeed. They just want you{CLEAR}to come home safe and sound.{CLEAR}So go back and see them.

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……你说的对！{NEWLINE}我这就回去！
strings.en: Waaah... You’re right!{NEWLINE}I’m going home right now!
